english.title: Government contractor fail to comply with direction for return or disposal of document or article
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to comply with an official direction for the

(A)_[return]_
(B)_[disposal]_

of

(C)_[a document]_
(D)_[an article]_

which, by virtue of your position as a government contractor, you had in your possession or under your control and for which it would be an offence under any of the foregoing provisions to section 8 of the Official Secrets Act 1989 for you to disclose without lawful authority
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 8(1)(b) and 10(2) of the Official Secrets Act 1989.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
by virtue of his/her position as a government contractor
had in his/her possession or under his/her control any document / article
which it would be an offence under any of the foregoing provisions of the Official Secrets Act 1989 for him to disclose without lawful authority
he/she failed to comply with an official direction for the return or disposal of the document or article

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
